title: 职位汇总：Supercell、Scopely、EA、Mattel、Tripledot、Zynga 等公司的人事变动与晋升
content:
Jobs digest: moves and promotions at Supercell, Scopely, EA, Mattel, Tripledot, Zynga and more – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Our jobs digest has all the recruitment news you need from across the mobile games business, all in one spot.
This column is sponsored by
FastSpring
.
FastSpring
: Global payments for your games from a partner you can trust with your players. Quickly launch a new web store, replace an existing D2C vendor, or add a redundant vendor at
fastspring.gg
.
Supercell
:
Kimmo Frisk
has joined as central QA specialist, having previous served in QA roles at Wiztivi Gaming and Iceflake Studios. Former Mediatonic, Fortis, and Tripledot artist
Vittorio Durin
has joined as senior technical artist, working on an unannounced project.
Yana Brusynska
joins as DevOps engineer on the server infra team, and former HiRez and Riot artists
Hans Hirth
has begun a new role as Supercell’s 3D artist and art outsource manager.
Tomás González Saavedra
also joins as a product manager on the Ops Royale team, covering a paternity leave contract role in Helsinki. He has previously held product management roles at Yodo1, Tilting Point and Gamehouse.
Supercell’s Frisk, Durin, Brusynska, Hirth and González Saavedra.
Scopely
: Former King talent manager
Albert Casas
has joined the global talent acquisition team at the Monopoly Go maker.
Tara Durbha
joins as associate game designer on Bingo Bash, while
Cory Taylor
joins as senior community manager on an unannounced upcoming title, having moved over from Warner Bros Games.
EA
:
Nick Nyaiesh
has taken on a new role at EA as game product manager, where he’ll be focused on EA’s American football mobile games. He joined EA in 2024 as associate game designer.
Mattel
:
Aamod Walavalkar
has joined the newly formed Mattel Games Studio as director of product and live ops, after close to a decade in mobile gaming at PeopleFun, Activision and Red Storm.
Scopely’s Casas, Durbha and Taylor, plus EA’s Nick N. and Mattel’s Walavalkar.
Tripledot
:
Ilya Buber
has joined Tripledot-owned Ludios as general manager, heading up its casual puzzle initiatives from Melbourne alongside a partner studio in Indonesia. He joins from EA-owned Glu.
Zynga
:
Andy Cheung
has joined as AdMon campaign manager, moving from Crunchyroll.
Tencent
:
Mustafa Yagiz Gulsun
has joined as casual games product expert, bringing with him experience from his time at Rollic and Homa.
Tripledot’s Buber, Zynga’s Cheung, Tencent’s Gulsun, Playamp’s Katasonov, Moon Active’s Gadish.
Playamp
:
Valerii Katasonov
has joined as DevOps team lead, responsible for D2C infrastructure including web stores, launcher and billing, after 12 years at Plarium. Playamp is MTG’s brand uniting its midcore studios – Plarium, InnoGames, Snowprint, Hutch, Ninja Kiwi and Futureplay.
Moon Active
:
Meytar Gadish
has been promoted to corporate development principal, having joined from iAngels as corporate development manager in 2025.
BoomBit
:
Gonçalo Alemao Martins
has been promoted to chief marketing officer, tied to the company’s push to grow external publishing partnerships through AppLifters.
Loom Games
:
Yusuf Gurkan
has joined as strategy and operations associate, moving from Bain & Company.
Testronic
:
Sonia Kerr
has been appointed as CEO, replacing Sharon Baylay-Bell, who moves into the role of company chair.
